$comment: Frictionless Table Schema v1. Cross-field rules live in docs/SCHEMA.md and are enforced by core/fosit/panel.py (CLI: schema/validate.py).
name: kpi_history
title: Historical KPI by geo and day
description: Long format, one row per date and geo. Used by Plan (history) and Read (history through end of test).

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar day in the advertiser's reporting time zone.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.description: Geo identifier in the plan's geo unit (CBSA code, state code, or user mapping ID).

fields.name: orders
fields.description: Count of orders (or conversions). Optional if revenue is present.

fields.name: revenue
fields.description: Revenue in the plan currency. Optional if orders is present. Negative values (net of returns) are allowed with a warning.
